definitions.explanation: A prefix used to refer to a person, place, or thing without specifying who or what it is. Used when the speaker deliberately conceals the identity or when the identity is unknown.

examples.japanese: {某|ぼう}⟦{大学|だいがく}→大学：00608_daigaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{教授|きょうじゅ}→教授：02589_kyouju⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{発表|はっぴょう}した→発表する：25231_happyousuru⟧。
examples.english: A professor at a certain university made the announcement.

examples.japanese: {某|ぼう}⟦{有名|ゆうめい}→有名：01106_yuumei⟧⟦{企業|きぎょう}→企業：00225_kigyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{社長|しゃちょう}→社長：01428_shachou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{逮捕|たいほ}→逮捕：03397_taiho⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The president of a certain famous company was arrested.

examples.japanese: ⟦{関係者|かんけいしゃ}→関係者：16441_kankeisha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{某氏|ぼうし}⟦によると→〜によると：03104_niyoruto⟧、⟦{計画|けいかく}→計画：01172_keikaku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{来月|らいげつ}→来月：00744_raigetsu⟧⟦{発表|はっぴょう}される→発表する：25231_happyousuru⟧らしい。
examples.english: According to a certain person involved, the plan will apparently be announced next month.

notes:
Used to refer to a person, place, or organization without naming them. Common in news reporting, storytelling, and formal writing when the identity is either unknown or deliberately withheld.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {某|ぼう} + noun: {某|ぼう}{国|こく} (a certain country), ⟦{某|ぼう}{社|しゃ}→某社：26014_bousha⟧ (a certain company), {某|ぼう}{氏|し} (a certain person)
- {某|ぼう}⟦{大学|だいがく}→大学：00608_daigaku⟧ — a certain university
- {某|ぼう}⟦{有名|ゆうめい}→有名：01106_yuumei⟧〜 — a certain famous ~

COMPOUNDS:
- {某氏|ぼうし} — a certain Mr./Ms.
- ⟦{某所|ぼうしょ}→某所：26015_bousho⟧ — a certain place
- {某国|ぼうこく} — a certain country
- {某日|ぼうじつ} — a certain day

REGISTER:
Fairly formal. In casual speech, people would say ⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧〜 (a certain ~) instead. {某|ぼう} is characteristic of news articles, official reports, and written narratives.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧ — a certain (more casual, everyday equivalent)
- {何某|なにがし} — somebody, so-and-so (more literary/archaic)
